meaning_en: The joint connecting your foot and leg.
example_en: I hurt my ankle playing football.
examples_extra: She twisted her ankle while running in the park yesterday.
He sat down and rubbed his sore ankle gently.
note_fa: در کتاب در بخش اعضای بدن (knee, wrist) آمده است.

meaning_en: The part of your body from shoulder to hand.
example_en: I hurt my arm playing tennis.
examples_extra: He broke his arm while playing football last week.
She held the baby gently in her arms.

meaning_en: The part of your body opposite your stomach.
example_en: My back hurts after carrying heavy bags.
examples_extra: I have a pain in my back after sitting at the desk all day.
He hurt his back when he lifted the heavy box alone.

meaning_en: To cut or hold something with your teeth.
example_en: The dog tried to bite my hand.
examples_extra: The dog may bite if you pull its tail.
She will bite the apple and smile happily.

meaning_en: To quickly close and open your eyes.
example_en: She blinked several times in the bright light.
examples_extra: She blinked several times in the bright sunlight.
He blinked in surprise when he heard the news.
note_fa: «پلک زدن» سریع؛ با wink (چشمک) فرق دارد.

meaning_en: The red liquid inside your body.
example_en: I saw some blood on my hand.
examples_extra: Blood carries oxygen to all parts of the body.
He gave blood at the hospital last month.

meaning_en: Clear your nose by forcing air through it.
example_en: He had a cold and had to blow his nose.
examples_extra: Use a clean tissue to blow your nose.
She blew her nose quietly before the interview.

meaning_en: Your face turns red because you are embarrassed.
example_en: She blushed when he complimented her dress.
examples_extra: She blushed when the teacher praised her work.
He blushed with embarrassment at the silly joke.

meaning_en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
example_en: Your body needs food and water.
examples_extra: Regular exercise is very good for your body.
His whole body was tired after the long race.

meaning_en: The lowest part of something.
example_en: The book fell to the bottom of the stairs.
examples_extra: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
Please sign your name at the bottom of the page.

meaning_en: The organ inside your head that controls thought.
example_en: Your brain helps you think and learn new things.
examples_extra: The human brain controls the whole human body.
Reading a little every day keeps your brain active.

meaning_en: Either of two soft parts on a woman's chest.
example_en: Babies drink milk from their mother's breast.
examples_extra: The tired baby slept on her mother's breast.
Grilled chicken breast is very low in fat.

meaning_en: The air you take in and let out.
example_en: Take a deep breath and relax.
examples_extra: He was completely out of breath after running.
Take a deep breath and try to stay calm.
note_fa: take a deep breath یعنی نفس عمیق کشیدن.

meaning_en: To take air in and let it out.
example_en: It's hard to breathe in this smoky room.
examples_extra: Just breathe slowly in through your nose now.
It is really hard to breathe in this smoky room.
note_fa: اسمش breath است — املا فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To take air into your lungs or push it out.
example_en: Breathe in slowly, then breathe out.
examples_extra: Breathe in slowly, and then breathe right out.
The doctor asked him to breathe in very deeply twice.

meaning_en: The soft part of your face below your eye.
example_en: She kissed her baby's soft cheek.
examples_extra: The baby has round red cheeks.
She kissed her grandmother on the cheek.

meaning_en: The front part of your body between your neck and stomach.
example_en: He felt a pain in his chest.
examples_extra: He felt a sharp pain in his chest.
She held the baby close to her chest.

meaning_en: To break food into small pieces with your teeth.
example_en: Please chew your food slowly.
examples_extra: You should chew your food slowly.
The dog is chewing a bone.

meaning_en: The part of your face below your mouth.
example_en: He has a small scar on his chin.
examples_extra: He rested his chin on his hands.
She lifted her chin and smiled at the camera.

meaning_en: To make your hair neat with a comb.
example_en: Please comb your hair before school.
examples_extra: I comb my hair every morning before breakfast.
She combed her hair in front of the mirror.
note_fa: comb هم فعل هم اسم است: a comb یعنی شانه.

meaning_en: To push air from your lungs with a loud sound.
example_en: He started to cough because of the smoke.
examples_extra: He coughed all night and could not sleep.
She coughed into her hand.
note_fa: هم فعل هم اسم است: a bad cough.

meaning_en: To produce tears from your eyes, usually from sadness.
example_en: The baby started to cry loudly.
examples_extra: The baby started to cry in the middle of the night.
She began to cry when she heard the good news.

meaning_en: The part of your body for hearing.
example_en: I heard a noise with my ear.
examples_extra: My little brother pulled my ear and ran away.
Elephants use their large ears to stay cool.

meaning_en: The middle part of your arm where it bends.
example_en: I hit my elbow on the table.
examples_extra: He hurt his elbow playing football.
She leaned her elbows on the table.

meaning_en: The part of your body you see with.
example_en: I have blue eyes.
examples_extra: She has beautiful green eyes.
He closed his eyes and tried to sleep.
note_fa: جمع eyes؛ keep an eye on یعنی «مراقب بودن».

meaning_en: The front part of your head.
example_en: She has a happy face.
examples_extra: She washed her face before breakfast.
His face turned red with embarrassment.
note_fa: با صفت ملکی می‌آید: wash my face.

meaning_en: The parts of your body you stand on. (plural of foot)
example_en: My feet hurt after walking all day.
examples_extra: My feet hurt after the long walk.
The baby has tiny feet.

meaning_en: One of the five parts at the end of your hand.
example_en: I hurt my finger playing basketball.
examples_extra: She hurt her finger while cutting the vegetables.
He pointed his finger at the map to show the way.
note_fa: انگشت دست؛ برای پا toe به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: To cross your arms over your chest.
example_en: He stood there with his arms folded.
examples_extra: She folded her arms and waited for an answer.
He folded his arms and stared at the floor.

meaning_en: The part of your leg you stand on.
example_en: My foot hurts after running.
examples_extra: My foot hurts after the long walk.
He kicked the ball with his right foot.
note_fa: جمع: feet. on foot یعنی پیاده.

meaning_en: the part of your face above your eyes.
example_en: She touched her forehead.
examples_extra: She wiped the sweat from her forehead.
He has a small scar on his forehead.

meaning_en: to make lines on your forehead, showing anger.
example_en: She frowned when she heard the news.
examples_extra: She frowned when she heard the news.
The teacher frowned at the noisy students.

meaning_en: a wide smile showing your teeth.
example_en: He gave a big grin when he saw me.
examples_extra: She grinned from ear to ear.
He gave a wide grin.
note_fa: «لبخند پهن»؛ grin from ear to ear.

meaning_en: Fine threads growing on your head.
example_en: She has long brown hair.
examples_extra: She has long black hair that reaches her waist.
He needs to cut his hair; it is getting too long.
note_fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش است: my hair is (نه are).

meaning_en: The part of your arm with fingers.
example_en: She waved her hand.
examples_extra: She held her baby's hand while crossing the street.
He raised his hand to ask the teacher a question.
note_fa: دست؛ give me a hand یعنی «کمکم کن».

meaning_en: The top part of your body.
example_en: My head hurts a little.
examples_extra: He slowly nodded his head in silent agreement.
She gently shook her head and smiled warmly.

meaning_en: The organ that pumps blood.
example_en: Your heart beats all the time.
examples_extra: Daily exercise keeps your heart strong and healthy.
His excited heart was beating incredibly fast.
note_fa: قلب؛ learn by heart یعنی حفظ کردن.

meaning_en: The back part of your foot.
example_en: My new shoes hurt my heels.
examples_extra: She wore elegant shoes with very high heels.
The small dog nipped playfully at his heel.
note_fa: پاشنه پا یا کفش؛ high heels.

meaning_en: The part of your body above your leg.
example_en: She put her hands on her hips.
examples_extra: She put her hands on her hips.
He hurt his hip playing football.

meaning_en: To stop breathing for a short time.
example_en: I can hold my breath for a minute.
examples_extra: How long can you hold your breath underwater?
She tried to hold her breath and jumped in.

meaning_en: The middle joint of your leg.
example_en: I hurt my knee playing football.
examples_extra: He hurt his knee playing football.
She sat the child on her knee.

meaning_en: To make sounds showing you find something funny.
example_en: We all laughed at his joke.
examples_extra: We laughed at his funny story.
Do not laugh at me!
note_fa: laugh at = به کسی خندیدن (مسخره کردن).

meaning_en: A part of the body used for walking.
example_en: I hurt my leg playing football.
examples_extra: The dog badly hurt its back left leg.
She crossed her long legs and sat down.
note_fa: پا (از ران تا مچ)؛ برای حیوان هم به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: Pass your tongue over something.
example_en: The dog licked my hand.
examples_extra: The cat licked its paws clean after eating.
She licked the ice cream off her fingers.

meaning_en: The edge of your mouth.
example_en: She bit her lip.
examples_extra: She bit her lower lip and stayed silent.
He had a small cut on his lip.
note_fa: لب؛ bite your lip یعنی «لب گزیدن» از نگرانی.

meaning_en: The two soft parts around your mouth.
example_en: She has red lips.
examples_extra: Her lips were dry from the cold wind.
She put some red colour on her lips.

meaning_en: Colouring for your lips.
example_en: She put on red lipstick.
examples_extra: She never leaves home without her lipstick.
The actress wore bright red lipstick that evening.

meaning_en: the part of your face used for eating
example_en: Open your mouth and say "Ah".
examples_extra: Please open your mouth really wide right now.
She covered her mouth and laughed softly again.

meaning_en: Hard part at the end of your finger or toe.
example_en: I broke my nail playing outside.
examples_extra: She painted her long nails a bright red.
He hit his thumb with the hammer, not the nail.

meaning_en: The part of the body connecting head and shoulders.
example_en: My neck hurts from sleeping badly.
examples_extra: She wore a warm scarf around her neck.
He woke up with a stiff, sore neck.

meaning_en: Move your head up and down to say yes.
example_en: She nodded her head to agree.
examples_extra: She nodded her head to show she agreed.
He nodded his head politely and walked away.
note_fa: سر تکان دادن به نشانه بله؛ nod هم یعنی همین.

meaning_en: The part of your face used for smelling.
example_en: I smell flowers with my nose.
examples_extra: She has a cold and her nose is red.
The dog pushed the door open with its nose.
note_fa: بینی؛ blow your nose یعنی «فین کردن».

meaning_en: Breathing fast and hard after exercise.
example_en: I ran so fast I was out of breath.
examples_extra: She was out of breath after climbing the stairs.
He arrived out of breath and sweating.

meaning_en: A bad feeling in your body when you are hurt.
example_en: I have a lot of pain in my leg.
examples_extra: I have a pain in my leg.
The pain went away quickly.

meaning_en: Sweat; liquid from your skin when hot.
example_en: After running, I had a lot of perspiration.
examples_extra: His shirt was wet with perspiration.
Perspiration cools the body in hot weather.

meaning_en: To sweat; to produce liquid from your skin.
example_en: I always perspire when I exercise.
examples_extra: He began to perspire in the heat.
She often perspires when she feels nervous.
note_fa: در کتاب رسمی‌تر از sweat معرفی شده.

meaning_en: To make a deep, continuous, low sound.
example_en: My stomach started to rumble because I was hungry.
examples_extra: Thunder rumbled in the distance.
My stomach rumbled during the exam.
note_fa: کتاب: my stomach rumbles؛ غرش/قاروقور شکم.

meaning_en: to move quickly from side to side or up and down
example_en: He shook his head in disagreement.
examples_extra: Shake the bottle before you drink.
The earthquake made the house shake.

meaning_en: to greet someone by holding their hand
example_en: They shook hands after the meeting.
examples_extra: We shake hands when we meet.
He refused to shake hands with me.

meaning_en: to move your head from side to side to say no
example_en: She shook her head, meaning "no".
examples_extra: He would shake his head in disbelief.
Do not shake your head at me.
note_fa: یعنی سر تکان دادن به علامت «نه».

meaning_en: to shake slightly because of cold or fear
example_en: I shivered in the cold wind.
examples_extra: He was so cold that he shivered.
She shivered badly in the freezing cold wind.

meaning_en: The part of your body between your neck and arm.
example_en: He carried the bag on his shoulder.
examples_extra: He gently tapped her on the right shoulder.
She always carries her bag on her shoulder.

meaning_en: A part of your body between your ribs and hip.
example_en: I have a pain in my side.
examples_extra: He always sleeps on his left side now.
Please park on the left side of the road.

meaning_en: To breathe out slowly and loudly, showing relief or sadness.
example_en: She sighed with relief when she finished.
examples_extra: She sighed deeply with pure relief once more.
He sighed heavily and looked sadly away again.

meaning_en: The outer covering of a person's body.
example_en: My skin is soft.
examples_extra: She has soft and smooth skin.
The snake sheds its skin.

meaning_en: To make your mouth turn up at the corners.
example_en: She always smiles at me.
examples_extra: She smiled at the baby.
He smiled when he saw me.

meaning_en: To suddenly push air from your nose and mouth.
example_en: I sneeze when I have a cold.
examples_extra: She sneezed three times in a row.
Black pepper always makes me sneeze.

meaning_en: To make a loud noise while sleeping.
example_en: My husband often snores loudly.
examples_extra: He snores loudly at night.
I could hear him snore loudly.

meaning_en: The part of your body where food goes.
example_en: My stomach hurts after eating too much.
examples_extra: My stomach really hurts after that meal.
She felt nervous butterflies in her stomach.

meaning_en: To pull liquid or air into your mouth.
example_en: The baby sucked its thumb for comfort.
examples_extra: The baby sucked his thumb.
She sucked the juice through a straw.

meaning_en: To make food or drink go down your throat.
example_en: It was hard to swallow the large pill.
examples_extra: Take a drink to help you swallow.
She swallowed the pill quickly.

meaning_en: To produce liquid from your skin when hot or nervous.
example_en: I started to sweat during the intense workout.
examples_extra: He was sweating after the run.
She sweats a lot in summer.

meaning_en: To breathe in a lot of air.
example_en: Take a deep breath and relax.
examples_extra: Take a deep breath and relax.
She takes a deep breath before speaking.

meaning_en: Hard white parts in your mouth for eating.
example_en: Brush your teeth twice a day.
examples_extra: Brush your teeth twice daily.
Babies grow teeth very early.

meaning_en: the short, thick finger on your hand.
example_en: I hurt my thumb playing basketball.
examples_extra: He cut his thumb while chopping vegetables.
She gave the idea a thumbs up.
note_fa: شست؛ انگشت کوتاه و ضخیم دست.

meaning_en: One of the five parts at the end of your foot.
example_en: I hurt my big toe on the table.
examples_extra: She hurt her big toe on the chair.
The newborn baby has ten very tiny toes.

meaning_en: Hard white part in your mouth for chewing.
example_en: My baby brother has his first tooth.
examples_extra: The happy baby already has its first tooth.
You should brush your teeth twice a day.

meaning_en: To shake slightly, often from fear or cold.
example_en: Her hands began to tremble as she opened the letter.
examples_extra: Her hands trembled with fear.
He trembled in the cold wind.
note_fa: کتاب: tremble = shake slightly؛ لرزیدن (از ترس/سرما).

meaning_en: The narrow part of your body between ribs and hips.
example_en: She tied a belt around her waist.
examples_extra: She wore a leather belt around her waist.
He gently put his arm around her waist.

meaning_en: To clean something with water and soap.
example_en: Please wash your hands before dinner.
examples_extra: Always wash your hands well before eating food.
She washed all the dirty dishes yesterday.

meaning_en: To move your hand to say hello or goodbye.
example_en: She waved to her friend across the street.
examples_extra: She waved to somebody across the street.
He waved happily to somebody at the window.

meaning_en: To close and open one eye quickly.
example_en: He winked at me to show it was a joke.
examples_extra: He winked at me and smiled.
She gave him a quick wink.

meaning_en: The joint connecting hand and arm.
example_en: I wear a watch on my wrist.
examples_extra: He wears a watch on his wrist.
She hurt her wrist playing tennis.

meaning_en: To open your mouth wide when tired.
example_en: He started to yawn because he was sleepy.
examples_extra: He yawned during the lesson.
She tried not to yawn.
